title: Future Reservations with Guest Profile and Revenue
description: Extracts information and statistics for FUTURE reservations including guest profile, address, room category, revenue breakdown, and booking metadata. Use RESERVATION_SUMMARY for future/upcoming reservations.
key_patterns: Use RESERVATION_SUMMARY for FUTURE reservations — it has CONSIDERED_DATE as the business date filter
RESERVATION_SUMMARY.EVENT_ID is the same identifier as RESV_NAME_ID in other tables
RESERVATION_NAME must be joined with NAME_USAGE_TYPE = 'DG' to get the primary (direct) guest
RESERVATION_NAME joins to RESERVATION_SUMMARY on CONFIRMATION_NO (not RESV_NAME_ID or EVENT_ID)
DSI and ORGANIZATIONID (exact casing) are the multi-environment keys — always include both in JOINs
RESORT$_ROOM_CATEGORY joined twice: once aliased 'rc' for ROOM_CATEGORY, once aliased 'bc' for BOOKED_ROOM_CATEGORY
NAME_ADDRESS deduplicated with ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY name_id, organizationid, dsi ORDER BY address_id DESC) with PRIMARY_YN='Y', INACTIVE_DATE IS NULL, NVL(DELETED_FLAG,'N')='N'
RAHTL_RESERVATION_GENERAL_VIEW joined on RESV_NAME_ID = r.EVENT_ID with DSI and ORGANIZATIONID
ALLOTMENT$HEADER joined on ALLOTMENT_HEADER_ID with status IN ('O','F') for open/fixed group blocks
APPLICATION$_USER joined twice for INSERT_USER and UPDATE_USER via APP_USER_ID (not USER_ID)
REGEXP_REPLACE(col, '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') used to clean control characters from all string columns
NVL(:p_from_date, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) pattern for optional date bind variables
TO_CHAR(date_col, 'YYYY-MM-DD') for date formatting
COALESCE(r.RESV_STATUS, ah.booking_status) for status with group block fallback
rahtl_profile_documents_view subquery for document type/number: inactive_date IS NULL, id_type NOT LIKE '%SUPPO%', primary_yn='Y', ROWNUM<=1
sql:
SELECT
    r.EVENT_ID AS RESV_NAME_ID,
    r.RESORT,
    r.DSI            AS DSI,
    r.ORGANIZATIONID AS ORGANIZATIONID,
    TO_CHAR(r.CONSIDERED_DATE,       'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
    TO_CHAR(r.BUSINESS_DATE_CREATED, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BUSINESS_DATE_CREATED,
    rn.NAME_ID AS NAME_ID,
    r.RATE_CODE,
    r.SOURCE_CODE,
    r.MARKET_CODE,
    COALESCE(r.RESV_STATUS, ah.booking_status) AS RESV_STATUS,
    r.CONFIRMATION_NO,
    TO_CHAR(r.TRUNC_BEGIN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ARRIVAL_DATE,
    TO_CHAR(r.TRUNC_END_DATE,   'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DEPARTURE_DATE,
    TO_CHAR(g.CANCELLATION_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CANCELLATION_DATE,
    r.CHILDREN,
    r.ADULTS,
    r.NO_ROOMS                              AS NO_OF_ROOMS,
    (r.TRUNC_END_DATE - r.TRUNC_BEGIN_DATE) AS NO_OF_NIGHTS,
    ROUND(r.TOTAL_REVENUE, 8) AS TOTAL_REVENUE,
    ROUND(r.ROOM_REVENUE, 8)  AS ROOM_REVENUE,
    ROUND(r.FOOD_REVENUE, 8)  AS FOOD_REVENUE,
    ROUND(r.OTHER_REVENUE, 8) AS OTHER_REVENUE,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(r.COUNTRY,     '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS COUNTRY,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(g.NATIONALITY, '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS NATIONALITY,
    n.EMAIL_YN,
    n.NAME_TYPE AS PROFILE_TYPE,
    n.GENDER,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(n.SFIRST, '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS SFIRST,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(n.SNAME,  '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS SNAME,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(n.TITLE,  '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS TITLE,
    n.BIRTH_DATE,
    (SELECT nd.id_type FROM rahtl_profile_documents_view nd
     WHERE nd.inactive_date IS NULL AND nd.dsi = r.DSI AND nd.organizationid = r.ORGANIZATIONID
       AND nd.id_type NOT LIKE '%SUPPO%' AND nd.primary_yn = 'Y' AND nd.name_id = rn.NAME_ID AND ROWNUM <= 1) AS tipodocumento,
    (SELECT nd.id_number FROM rahtl_profile_documents_view nd
     WHERE nd.inactive_date IS NULL AND nd.dsi = r.DSI AND nd.organizationid = r.ORGANIZATIONID
       AND nd.id_type NOT LIKE '%SUPPO%' AND nd.primary_yn = 'Y' AND nd.name_id = rn.NAME_ID AND ROWNUM <= 1) AS numerodocumento,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(na.ADDRESS1, '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS ADDRESS1,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(na.CITY,     '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS CITY,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(na.ZIP_CODE, '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS ZIP_CODE,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(g.GUEST_EMAIL,       '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS GUEST_EMAIL,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(g.GUEST_PHONE,       '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS GUEST_PHONE,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(g.TRAVEL_AGENT_NAME, '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS TRAVEL_AGENT_NAME,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(g.COMPANY_NAME,      '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS COMPANY_NAME,
    g.COMPANY_ID,
    g.TRAVEL_AGENT_ID,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(bc.LABEL, '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS BOOKED_ROOM_CATEGORY_LABEL,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(rc.LABEL, '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS ROOM_CATEGORY_LABEL,
    g.ROOM AS ROOM_NO,
    g.PAYMENT_AMOUNT,
    g.TA_RECORD_LOCATOR,
    r.allotment_header_id,
    TO_CHAR(r.BUSINESS_DATE_CREATED, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS INSERT_DATE,
    g.INSERT_USER,
    g.UPDATE_USER,
    r.NET_ROOM_REVENUE AS RATE_AMOUNT,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(g.GROUP_NAME, ah.DESCRIPTION), '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS GROUP_NAME,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(u_ins.APP_USER, '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS INSERT_USER_NAME,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(u_upd.APP_USER, '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS UPDATE_USER_NAME
FROM RESERVATION_SUMMARY r
LEFT JOIN RESORT$_ROOM_CATEGORY rc ON r.ROOM_CATEGORY = rc.ROOM_CATEGORY AND r.RESORT = rc.RESORT
LEFT JOIN RESORT$_ROOM_CATEGORY bc ON r.BOOKED_ROOM_CATEGORY = bc.ROOM_CATEGORY AND r.RESORT = bc.RESORT
LEFT JOIN RESERVATION_NAME rn ON rn.CONFIRMATION_NO = r.CONFIRMATION_NO AND rn.NAME_USAGE_TYPE = 'DG'
LEFT JOIN NAME n ON n.NAME_ID = rn.NAME_ID AND n.DSI = r.DSI AND n.ORGANIZATIONID = r.ORGANIZATIONID
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT name_id, organizationid, dsi, address1, city, zip_code
    FROM (SELECT na.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY na.name_id, na.organizationid, na.dsi ORDER BY na.address_id DESC) AS rn
          FROM NAME_ADDRESS na WHERE na.PRIMARY_YN = 'Y' AND na.INACTIVE_DATE IS NULL AND NVL(na.DELETED_FLAG, 'N') = 'N')
    WHERE rn = 1
) na ON na.NAME_ID = rn.NAME_ID AND na.DSI = r.DSI AND na.ORGANIZATIONID = r.ORGANIZATIONID
LEFT JOIN RAHTL_RESERVATION_GENERAL_VIEW g ON g.RESV_NAME_ID = r.EVENT_ID AND g.DSI = r.DSI AND g.ORGANIZATIONID = r.ORGANIZATIONID
LEFT JOIN ALLOTMENT$HEADER ah ON ah.ALLOTMENT_HEADER_ID = r.allotment_header_id AND ah.status IN ('O','F')
LEFT JOIN APPLICATION$_USER u_ins ON u_ins.APP_USER_ID = g.INSERT_USER AND u_ins.DSI = g.DSI AND u_ins.ORGANIZATIONID = g.ORGANIZATIONID
LEFT JOIN APPLICATION$_USER u_upd ON u_upd.APP_USER_ID = g.UPDATE_USER AND u_upd.DSI = g.DSI AND u_upd.ORGANIZATIONID = g.ORGANIZATIONID
WHERE r.RESORT = :p_resorts
  AND r.CONSIDERED_DATE >= NVL(:p_from_date, TRUNC(SYSDATE))
  AND r.CONSIDERED_DATE <= NVL(:p_to_date, TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, 12), 'YYYY') - 1)
ORDER BY r.TRUNC_BEGIN_DATE, r.ROOM_CATEGORY, r.RATE_CODE

title: Past Reservations Statistics
description: Extracts information about PAST reservations from RESERVATION_STAT_DAILY. Use this table (not RESERVATION_SUMMARY) for historical/completed stay data. Filtered by BUSINESS_DATE.
key_patterns: Use RESERVATION_STAT_DAILY for PAST/historical reservations — filter on BUSINESS_DATE
Use RESERVATION_SUMMARY for FUTURE reservations — filter on CONSIDERED_DATE
RESERVATION_STAT_DAILY has STAY_ROOMS (not NO_ROOMS) for number of rooms
RESERVATION_STAT_DAILY has NIGHTS (not NO_OF_NIGHTS) for number of nights
RESERVATION_STAT_DAILY has INSERT_DATE, BIRTH_DATE, NATIONALITY, COUNTRY directly on the table
RESERVATION_STAT_DAILY has RESV_NAME_ID directly (unlike RESERVATION_SUMMARY which uses EVENT_ID)
RAHTL_RESERVATION_GENERAL_VIEW joined on RESV_NAME_ID (direct) when using RESERVATION_STAT_DAILY
NAME_ADDRESS can be joined directly (without ROW_NUMBER subquery) using PRIMARY_YN='Y', INACTIVE_DATE IS NULL, NVL(DELETED_FLAG,'N')='N'
APPLICATION$_USER joined on APP_USER_ID (not USER_ID) with DSI and ORGANIZATIONID
RESORT$_ROOM_CATEGORY joined twice: 'rc' for ROOM_CATEGORY, 'bc' for BOOKED_ROOM_CATEGORY
Default date range for past data: NVL(:p_from_date, TRUNC(SYSDATE)-7) to NVL(:p_to_date, TRUNC(SYSDATE)-1)
sql:
SELECT
    r.RESORT,
    TO_CHAR(r.BUSINESS_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') BUSINESS_DATE,
    r.NAME_ID,
    r.RATE_CODE,
    r.SOURCE_CODE,
    r.MARKET_CODE,
    r.COMPANY_ID,
    r.AGENT_ID,
    r.RESV_STATUS,
    TO_CHAR(r.TRUNC_BEGIN_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') ARRIVAL_DATE,
    TO_CHAR(r.TRUNC_END_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') DEPARTURE_DATE,
    TO_CHAR(r.CANCELLATION_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') CANCELLATION_DATE,
    r.RESV_NAME_ID,
    g.CONFIRMATION_NO,
    g.TA_RECORD_LOCATOR,
    g.INSERT_USER,
    g.UPDATE_USER,
    g.GROUP_ID,
    r.RATE_AMOUNT,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(bc.LABEL, '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS BOOKED_ROOM_CATEGORY_LABEL,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(rc.LABEL, '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS ROOM_CATEGORY_LABEL,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(g.GUEST_EMAIL,       '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS GUEST_EMAIL,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(g.GUEST_PHONE,       '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS GUEST_PHONE,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(g.TRAVEL_AGENT_NAME, '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS TRAVEL_AGENT_NAME,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(g.COMPANY_NAME,      '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS COMPANY_NAME,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(g.GROUP_NAME,        '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS GROUP_NAME,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(u_ins.APP_USER, '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS INSERT_USER_NAME,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(u_upd.APP_USER, '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS UPDATE_USER_NAME,
    r.CHILDREN,
    r.ADULTS,
    ROUND(r.TOTAL_REVENUE,8) TOTAL_REVENUE,
    ROUND(r.ROOM_REVENUE,8)  ROOM_REVENUE,
    ROUND(r.FOOD_REVENUE,8)  FOOD_REVENUE,
    ROUND(r.OTHER_REVENUE,8) OTHER_REVENUE,
    TO_CHAR(r.INSERT_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') CREATION_DATE,
    r.ROOM ROOM_NO,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(r.COUNTRY,     '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS COUNTRY,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(r.NATIONALITY, '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS NATIONALITY,
    r.STAY_ROOMS NO_OF_ROOMS,
    r.NIGHTS     NO_OF_NIGHTS,
    r.BIRTH_DATE,
    n.EMAIL_YN,
    n.NAME_TYPE PROFILE_TYPE,
    n.GENDER,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(n.SFIRST, '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS SFIRST,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(n.SNAME,  '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS SNAME,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(n.TITLE,  '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS TITLE,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(na.ADDRESS1, '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS ADDRESS1,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(na.CITY,     '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS CITY,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(na.ZIP_CODE, '[[:cntrl:]|]', '') AS ZIP_CODE,
    (SELECT name_documents.id_type FROM rahtl_profile_documents_view name_documents
     WHERE name_documents.inactive_date IS NULL AND name_documents.dsi = r.dsi
       AND name_documents.organizationid = r.organizationid
       AND name_documents.id_type NOT LIKE '%SUPPO%' AND name_documents.primary_yn = 'Y'
       AND na.name_id = name_documents.name_id AND na.organizationid = name_documents.organizationid
       AND na.dsi = name_documents.dsi AND ROWNUM <= 1) tipodocumento,
    (SELECT name_documents.id_number FROM rahtl_profile_documents_view name_documents
     WHERE name_documents.inactive_date IS NULL AND name_documents.dsi = r.dsi
       AND name_documents.organizationid = r.organizationid
       AND name_documents.id_type NOT LIKE '%SUPPO%' AND name_documents.primary_yn = 'Y'
       AND na.name_id = name_documents.name_id AND na.organizationid = name_documents.organizationid
       AND na.dsi = name_documents.dsi AND ROWNUM <= 1) numerodocumento
FROM RESERVATION_STAT_DAILY r
LEFT JOIN NAME n
       ON r.NAME_ID = n.NAME_ID AND n.organizationid = r.organizationid AND n.dsi = r.dsi
LEFT JOIN NAME_ADDRESS na
       ON r.NAME_ID = na.NAME_ID AND na.PRIMARY_YN = 'Y' AND na.Inactive_Date IS NULL
      AND NVL(na.Deleted_Flag, 'N') = 'N' AND na.organizationid = r.organizationid AND na.dsi = r.dsi
LEFT JOIN RAHTL_RESERVATION_GENERAL_VIEW g
       ON r.RESV_NAME_ID = g.RESV_NAME_ID AND r.organizationid = g.organizationid AND g.dsi = r.dsi
LEFT JOIN RESORT$_ROOM_CATEGORY rc ON r.ROOM_CATEGORY = rc.ROOM_CATEGORY AND r.RESORT = rc.RESORT
LEFT JOIN RESORT$_ROOM_CATEGORY bc ON r.BOOKED_ROOM_CATEGORY = bc.ROOM_CATEGORY AND r.RESORT = bc.RESORT
LEFT JOIN APPLICATION$_USER u_ins
       ON u_ins.APP_USER_ID = g.INSERT_USER AND u_ins.organizationid = g.organizationid AND u_ins.dsi = g.dsi
LEFT JOIN APPLICATION$_USER u_upd
       ON u_upd.APP_USER_ID = g.UPDATE_USER AND u_upd.organizationid = g.organizationid AND u_upd.dsi = g.dsi
WHERE r.RESORT = :p_resorts
  AND r.BUSINESS_DATE >= NVL(:p_from_date, TRUNC(SYSDATE)-7)
  AND r.BUSINESS_DATE <= NVL(:p_to_date,   TRUNC(SYSDATE)-1)
ORDER BY r.resv_name_id

title: Daily Financial Transactions with Fiscal Tax Validation
description: Extracts daily financial folio transactions for reservations with full fiscal/tax ID validation per country. Uses CTE for document lookup and validates tax ID format for EU countries.
key_patterns: prt_property is joined using datasourceid (NOT dsi) to match against ftax.dsi: p.datasourceid = ftax.dsi
prt_property has active=1 filter for active properties
rahtl_folio_tax_view contains folio/billing data: bill_no, status, folio_type, bill_generation_date, payee_name_id, PROPERTY_BILL_PREFIX, associated_bill_no
rahtl_profile_all_view (aliased 'payee') contains full profile: name_type_description, tax1_no, country_code, last, first, name_id
name_type_description values: 'COMPANY', 'TRAVEL AGENT', 'SOURCE', 'INDIVIDUAL' — used to determine tax ID source
For COMPANY/TRAVEL AGENT/SOURCE profiles: use payee.tax1_no for tax ID
For INDIVIDUAL profiles: use rahtl_profile_documents_view subquery for document number
rahtl_exp_mapping_view provides fiscal ID type mappings: joined on mapping_type='FISCAL_ID_TYPES', mapping_code, linked_code
application_parameter_values filtered by parameter_name='PROPERTY_TAX_ID' for property-level tax config
WITH clause (CTE) used for name_docs to pre-filter document records
ftax.status <> 'VOID' to exclude voided folios
NVL(UPPER(ftax.folio_type), 'INTERNAL') <> 'INTERNAL' to exclude internal folios
REGEXP_LIKE used for country-specific tax ID format validation (NIF/CIF/VAT number patterns)
sql:
WITH name_docs AS (
    SELECT nd.name_id, nd.id_type, nd.id_number, nd.organizationid, nd.dsi, mp.resort
    FROM rahtl_profile_documents_view nd
    JOIN rahtl_exp_mapping_view mp
      ON mp.resort = :p_resorts AND mp.mapping_type = 'FISCAL_ID_TYPES'
     AND mp.mapping_code = 'MC_GENERIC1' AND nd.id_type = mp.linked_code
     AND nd.inactive_date IS NULL AND nd.dsi = mp.dsi AND nd.organizationid = mp.organizationid
     AND nd.primary_yn = 'Y' AND nd.id_type NOT LIKE '%SUPPO%'
)
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(ftax.bill_no) AS FACTURA,
    TO_CHAR(ftax.status) AS STATUS,
    ftax.folio_type,
    ftax.bill_no,
    ftax.resort,
    TO_CHAR(ftax.bill_generation_date, 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS fecha,
    (payee.last || ' ' || payee.first) AS nombrerazon,
    ftax.name_type_description AS TipoProfile,
    NVL(payee.country_code, ' ') AS codigopais,
    CASE
        WHEN UPPER(payee.name_type_description) IN ('COMPANY','TRAVEL AGENT','SOURCE') THEN payee.tax1_no
        WHEN UPPER(payee.name_type_description) = 'INDIVIDUAL' THEN
            (SELECT nd2.id_number FROM rahtl_profile_documents_view nd2
             WHERE nd2.inactive_date IS NULL AND nd2.id_type NOT LIKE '%SUPPO%'
               AND nd2.primary_yn = 'Y' AND nd2.name_id = payee.name_id
               AND nd2.organizationid = payee.organizationid AND nd2.dsi = payee.dsi AND ROWNUM = 1)
    END AS id
FROM prt_property p
JOIN rahtl_folio_tax_view ftax
    ON p.organizationid = ftax.organizationid AND p.datasourceid = ftax.dsi AND p.resort = ftax.resort
JOIN rahtl_profile_all_view payee
    ON payee.name_id = ftax.payee_name_id AND payee.organizationid = ftax.organizationid AND payee.dsi = ftax.dsi
LEFT JOIN name_docs
    ON payee.name_id = name_docs.name_id AND payee.organizationid = name_docs.organizationid
   AND payee.dsi = name_docs.dsi AND ftax.resort = name_docs.resort
JOIN application_parameter_values pn
    ON pn.dsi = ftax.dsi AND pn.organizationid = ftax.organizationid AND pn.resort = ftax.resort
WHERE p.resort = :p_resorts AND p.active = 1
  AND ftax.resort = :p_resorts
  AND ftax.bill_generation_date BETWEEN NVL(:p_from_date, TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND NVL(:p_to_date, TRUNC(SYSDATE))
  AND ftax.status <> 'VOID'
  AND NVL(UPPER(ftax.folio_type), 'INTERNAL') <> 'INTERNAL'
  AND pn.parameter_name = 'PROPERTY_TAX_ID'
ORDER BY ftax.bill_no

title: Police Registration - Guest ID and Accompanying Guests
description: Extracts police/fiscal registration data for checked-in and checked-out guests, including ID documents, nationality, address, and relationship info. Also demonstrates how to extract ACCOMPANYING guests (name_usage_type=AG) vs main guests (DG). Uses RAHTL_reservation_VIEW for reservation data and RAHTL_NAME_KEYWORDS_VIEW for Spanish last name fields.
key_patterns: RAHTL_reservation_VIEW is the main view for reservation data including actual_check_in_date and guest info
name_usage_type = 'DG' is the main/direct guest; name_usage_type = 'AG' is an accompanying guest
For accompanying guests (AG): use parent_resv_name_id to link back to the main reservation
DECODE(rn.name_usage_type, 'AG', rn.parent_resv_name_id, rn.resv_name_id) unifies reservation ID across guest types
RAHTL_NAME_KEYWORDS_VIEW joined twice (aliased mother/father) for Spanish last names: UPPER(keyword_type)='MLASTNAME' and keyword_type='PLASTNAME'
RAHTL_PROFILE_RELATIONSHIP_VW joined on OWNER_PROFILE_ID + PRIMARY_FLAG='Y' to get relationship type (parentesco)
ISO_COUNTRY_CODES_EV joined twice: once for nationality_code, once for country_code — converts CHAR_CODE2 to CHAR_CODE3 (ISO 3-letter code)
rahtl_exp_mapping_view with mapping_code='MC_GENERIC2' retrieves the support document type (MC_GENERIC1 is for primary document)
rahtl_profile_documents_view for name_support: id_type LIKE '%SUPPORT%' AND primary_yn != 'Y' for secondary/support document
na.name_type = 'D' filters for individual guest profiles only
prt_property joined with datasourceid = rn.dsi AND active = 1
Oracle outer join (+) syntax is valid in production
resv_status checked with UPPER(nvl(rn.resv_status,'1')) IN ('CHECKED IN','CHECKED OUT','1')
nvl(rn.room_category,'1') NOT LIKE '-%' excludes pseudo-room categories
actual_check_in_date used for date range filter (not arrival_date or business_date)
sql:
select DISTINCT
        'VI'                                                                rol             ,
        nvl(na.name2, nvl(na.udfc01,''))                                 apellido1       ,
        nvl(na.name3, nvl(na.udfc02,''))                                 apellido2       ,
        name_documents.id_type                                              tipoDocumento   ,
        name_documents.id_number                                            numeroDocumento ,
        name_support.id_number                                              soporteDocumento,
        nvl(rn.GUEST_FIRST,'')                                              first           ,
        nvl(to_char(to_date(na.BIRTH_DATE_STR), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '1900-01-01')fechaNacimiento ,
        iso_code_nat.char_code3                                             nacionalidad    ,
        decode(na.gender,
               'M'      , 'H',
               'M')                            sexo                   ,
        nvl(na.address1,'')                    direccion              ,
        nvl(na.address2,'')                    direccionComplementaria,
        ''                                     codigoMunicipio        ,
        ''                                     nombreMunicipio        ,
        nvl(na.zip_code,'')                    codigoPostal           ,
        nvl(iso_code_country.char_code3,'UND') pais                   ,
        nvl(substr(na.phone_no,1,15),'')       telefono               ,
        decode(nvl(na.phone_no,'1'),
               '1'                 , ' ',
               '')                              telefono2 ,
        nvl(substr(na.e_mail,1,40),'')          correo    ,
        relation_profile.RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_CODE parentesco,
        ACTUAL_CHECK_IN_DATE                              ,
        dECODE(rn.name_usage_type,
               'AG'              ,rn.parent_resv_name_id,
               rn.resv_name_id) resv_name_id ,
        rn.resort               resort       ,
        rn.dsi                  dsi          ,
        rn.organizationid       organizationid
FROM
        RAHTL_reservation_VIEW rn ,
        RAHTL_PROFILE_ALL_VIEW na ,
        prt_property           p,
        (
                select
                        mother.name_id name_id  ,
                        mother.organizationid   ,
                        mother.dsi              ,
                        mother.KEYWORD mlastname,
                        father.keyword flastname
                from
                        RAHTL_NAME_KEYWORDS_VIEW mother,
                        RAHTL_NAME_KEYWORDS_VIEW father
                where
                        UPPER(mother.keyword_type) = 'MLASTNAME'
                and     (father.keyword_type) = 'PLASTNAME'
                and     mother.name_id               = father.name_id
                and     mother.organizationid        = father.organizationid
                and     mother.dsi                   = father.dsi ) nk,
        (
                SELECT
                        name_documents.name_id                      ,
                        mp.export_value id_type                     ,
                        name_documents.id_number                    ,
                        name_documents.organizationid organizationid,
                        name_documents.dsi            dsi           ,
                        mp.resort                     resort        ,
                        name_documents.inactive_date  inactive_date ,
                        name_documents.primary_YN     primary_yn
                FROM
                        rahtl_profile_documents_view name_documents,
                        rahtl_exp_mapping_view       mp
                WHERE
                        mp.resort              = :p_resorts
                AND     mp.mapping_type        = 'FISCAL_ID_TYPES'
                AND     mp.mapping_code        = 'MC_GENERIC2'
                AND     name_documents.id_type = mp.linked_code
                AND     name_documents.inactive_date IS NULL
                AND     name_documents.dsi            = mp.dsi
                AND     name_documents.organizationid = mp.organizationid
                AND     name_documents.id_type NOT    LIKE '%SUPPO%' ) name_documents  ,
        RAHTL_PROFILE_DOCUMENTS_VIEW                                   name_support    ,
        RAHTL_PROFILE_RELATIONSHIP_VW                                  relation_profile,
        ISO_COUNTRY_CODES_EV                                           iso_code_nat    ,
        ISO_COUNTRY_CODES_EV                                           iso_code_country
WHERE
        rn.resort                    = :p_resorts
and     p.resort = :p_resorts
AND     p.active = 1
AND     p.organizationid = rn.organizationid
AND     p.datasourceid = rn.dsi
AND     p.resort = rn.resort
and     na.name_id                   = rn.name_id
and     na.organizationid            = rn.organizationid
and     na.dsi                       = rn.dsi
and     na.name_id                   = name_documents.name_id (+)
AND     name_documents.primary_yn(+) = 'Y'
and     name_documents.inactive_date(+) IS NULL
and     na.organizationid                 = name_documents.organizationid(+)
and     na.dsi                            = name_documents.dsi(+)
and     na.name_id                        = nk.name_id(+)
and     na.organizationid                 = nk.organizationid(+)
and     na.dsi                            = nk.dsi(+)
and     na.name_id                        = name_support.name_id (+)
and     na.organizationid                 = name_support.organizationid(+)
and     na.dsi                            = name_support.dsi(+)
and     upper(name_support.id_type(+))    like '%SUPPORT%'
AND     name_support.primary_yn(+)        <> 'Y'
and     na.name_type                      = 'D'
and     na.name_id                        = relation_profile.OWNER_PROFILE_ID(+)
and     na.dsi                            = relation_profile.dsi(+)
and     na.organization_id                = relation_profile.organization_id(+)
and     relation_profile.PRIMARY_FLAG(+)  ='Y'
and     iso_code_nat.CHAR_CODE2(+)        = na.nationality_code
and     iso_code_nat.dsi(+)               = na.dsi
and     iso_code_nat.organizationid(+)    = na.organizationid
and     iso_code_country.char_code2(+)    = na.country_code
and     iso_code_country.dsi(+)           = na.dsi
and     iso_code_country.organizationid(+)= na.organizationid
and     UPPER(nvl(rn.resv_status,'1')) in( 'CHECKED IN',
                                           'CHECKED OUT', '1')
and     nvl(rn.room_category,'1') NOT LIKE '-%'
and     trunc(rn.actual_check_in_date) BETWEEN :p_from_date and :p_to_date
order by 1
